summary.text: Sari Domingues is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was born in Santa Maria, California, and has worked as a business analyst and IT specialist.

paragraphs.text: Domingues graduated from Santa Maria High School, earned an associate degree from Allan Hancock College in 1991, a bachelor's degree from the University of La Verne in 1995 and a graduate degree from Chapman University in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists her as having been affiliated with Moms for Liberty Santa Barbara County.
